item.html:
What is Commercial Roof Restoration?

A full commercial roof replacement is a massive capital expenditure. Fortunately, if your existing flat or low-slope roof is aging but still structurally sound, there is a much more cost-effective solution: Commercial Roof Restoration. Instead of tearing off miles of roofing material, we apply a state-of-the-art, liquid-applied roof coating directly over your existing membrane (such as TPO, PVC, EPDM, or Modified Bitumen).

At Core Four Roofing, we use premium silicone and acrylic elastomeric coatings. When sprayed or rolled onto the roof, this liquid cures into a thick, seamless, and incredibly durable rubber-like membrane. It completely seals around complex HVAC penetrations, fills microscopic cracks, and eliminates vulnerable seams where leaks typically form. This process effectively resets the clock on your aging roof, providing decades of new life while reflecting the brutal Texas sun away from your building.

item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Roof Coatings
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Commercial Roof Coatings

items.q: Can every commercial roof be coated?
items.a: No. A roof must be a good candidate for restoration. If core samples reveal that more than 25% of the underlying insulation is saturated with water, or if the roof deck is structurally compromised, a coating will trap that moisture and fail. We perform rigorous inspections to ensure your roof is eligible before recommending a coating.

items.q: How long does a commercial roof coating last in Texas?
items.a: Depending on the thickness of the application (the "mils") and the type of material used, a high-quality commercial roof coating can extend the life of your roof by 10 to 20 years. Better yet, once that lifespan is up, the roof can simply be cleaned and re-coated, creating a renewable roofing system.

items.q: What is the difference between Silicone and Acrylic coatings?
items.a: Acrylic coatings are highly reflective and cost-effective, making them great for roofs with excellent positive drainage. Silicone coatings are more premium; they are completely waterproof and will not degrade under ponding water, making them the superior choice for flat roofs with drainage issues.

items.q: Will the application process disrupt my business?
items.a: Not at all. Roof coatings are applied with virtually zero noise, no heavy tear-off equipment, and very little odor. Your tenants, customers, and daily operations will continue completely uninterrupted.
